one_liner: Intuit's small-business accounting platform (QuickBooks Online) with an API for invoicing, accounting, and payments data.

auth.evidence_quote: The QuickBooks API uses OAuth 2.0 exclusively — there are no API keys or basic authentication options.
auth.notes: Evidence page is a third-party developer guide, not Intuit's own docs (developer.intuit.com pages repeatedly failed to fetch full content in this pass); auth mechanism is well corroborated by common knowledge of Intuit's platform.

access.evidence_quote: A QuickBooks developer account is free, with immediate sandbox access, up to five sandbox companies, and all developer tools at no cost.
access.notes: Same source states production (live) access requires Intuit app assessment/review before going live on real accounts; direct Intuit docs page confirming this could not be fetched within budget.

api.notes: Could not confirm official MCP server or exact endpoint count within pass-1 budget; developer.intuit.com pages returned truncated content on every fetch attempt.

verdict.rationale: Free developer account with immediate sandbox access allows building and testing immediately; production requires app review but sandbox development is unblocked.
